shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in strict profile
standing/striding figures with long garments and detailed hair and beard
figures carrying or holding objects in the hand
justification: Both depict low-relief profile human figures with long robes, curled hair and beards holding objects, rendered with similar flat-relief, contour-and-detail conventions, and both include a stylized tree and profile animals. However A is a single monumental isolated winged genie filling the whole field, while B is a multi-register procession of many small figures leading animals, so the compositional relationships and arrangement differ sharply.
